meta.name: competitive-intel-watch
meta.description: Scheduled delta monitoring against a prior competitive snapshot. Use when tracking competitors on a cadence: material shifts only, cited evidence, battle-card update flags, runs unattended.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定时追踪竞品动态，只推送实质性变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期跟踪竞品并自动生成战报
copy.tagline_en: Track competitors on a schedule, get only material changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor competitors regularly and auto-generate battle cards

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会拿你之前给的竞争快照作基线,定期扫描对手变化,只挑值得行动的重大变动(如定价、发布、人事、融资等),附证据(网址+日期),并标明哪些战卡或定位部分需要更新。没有明显变化时就明确说'本周期无重大变化',可无人值守按计划跑。
howto.when: 当你给它上一份竞争快照并要它按周期对比跟踪,或要求检查自上次以来的实质变化时触发;没有快照时会先建立基线。

say.text: 这是上季度的竞争快照,对比它,列出所有重大变化及证据。
say.note: 技能会按材料性门槛筛选,输出带日期和链接的变更日志。

say.text: 以后每月自动跑一次竞争监测,空结果也算,并标记要更新的战卡。
say.note: 设成定期无人值守运行,有变化才报警。

say.text: 这轮只盯定价和产品下架,其余变化不用报。
say.note: 通过关注点调整过滤范围,低于门槛的只进观察清单。

howto.what_en: Given a prior snapshot, Claude scans for material shifts since then, reports only changes with dated evidence, and flags which battle-card/positioning sections need updating. Runs unattended; empty changelog is a valid, useful result.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a prior competitive snapshot is supplied and a cadence-based delta watch is requested. Without a snapshot, it builds a baseline first then stops.

say_en.text: Here's last quarter's snapshot. Diff it and list all material changes with evidence.
say_en.note: Filters by the materiality bar and outputs a dated changelog.

say_en.text: Run a monthly competitor watch automatically; empty result is fine, flag battle-card updates.
say_en.note: Scheduled unattended run; only changes are reported.

say_en.text: This cycle, watch only pricing and product removals; skip the rest.
say_en.note: Adjusts focus; below-bar signals go to the watchlist.
